botContact.title: The bot has to share a server with you
botContact.body: Discord login creates the account or opens it. Login itself does not invite the bot and does not add you to a server. The bot records play only when you share a server — you join the GameTrace server, or you invite the bot to yours.
botContact.permission: Discord will ask which servers you are in. GameTrace only checks whether the bot is already in one. Refusing cancels login.
botContact.addBot: ADD THE BOT TO A SERVER

botReminder.title: The bot cannot see you
botReminder.body: Without a shared server the bot will not record play. Join the GameTrace server or invite the bot to yours. Manual sessions in the app still work.
botReminder.addBot: ADD THE BOT TO A SERVER
